decisions.statement: A talosconfig that is not there refuses the check.
The talosconfig read sits at `<home>/.talos/<cluster>.config`, where `akasha talos apply` writes it.
talosctl writes the check's own output to the streams the call was made on.
The control plane is the node asked where no control-plane address is named.
An address list is read as its trimmed comma-separated parts.
An empty part of an address list is dropped rather than being an address.
Worker nodes are named to the check only where a worker address is named.
Every answer here is built by a function rather than written out as a value.

definition: the command running the talosctl health check over a Talos cluster
